item.description:
Dax 3.9.7

  • The camera and microphone work in released builds again. Dax now asks for them the first time you use them and appears in System Settings › Privacy & Security, so you can turn them on.
  • When a permission is on in System Settings but Dax still can’t use it, Dax now shows you what to do to fix it.
  • Agents in the agent watcher are drawn as folder tiles.
  • Redeem a code for free credits from the Credits panel.
  • Updates after installing from the PKG now install without asking for your password.
